title: Atomic Prometheus rollout and immutable Grafana dashboard deploys for Private installs
author: Lucas Meyer
description: Motivation: private installs running in regulated VPCs need safe, automated observability upgrades that can be rolled forward or back without manual intervention or metric churn. This PR implements an end-to-end, rollback-safe flow for Prometheus upgrades and a mechanism for immutable Grafana dashboard provisioning so dashboards deployed by Private Installer do not get silently mutated during upgrades. What changed: 1) terraform/modules/monitoring: added a monitoring_upgrade_plan module that tracks desired Prometheus operator image/tag, alert rule migration manifests, and a migration lock resource to coordinate cluster-wide upgrades; 2) helm_charts/prometheus: introduced pre-upgrade helm hooks that run a lightweight rule-validation Job and create a temporary canary StatefulSet (prometheus-canary) which runs scraping and rule evaluation against a sampled subset of targets; the helm release is only promoted after the canary passes smoke tests; 3) helm_charts/grafana: dashboards are now written as immutable configmaps named with a content hash and routed into a tenant-specific, release-locked Grafana folder via provisioning; old dashboard configmaps are retained for fast rollback; 4) installer/upgrade: new orchestration script observability-upgrade.sh which drives terraform plan/apply, triggers Helm canary promotion, waits for smoke checks, and handles automatic rollback on failure; 5) alertmanager: added a staged alertgroup migration that duplicates existing groups to a v2 path and switches routing atomically via a ConfigMap flip; 6) docs and smoke tests: update to private-installer/README and added e2e test that exercises canary rule evaluation and dashboard provisioning. Rollout plan: start with a small cohort of internal tenants, run canary for 24 hours, and then schedule a full cluster promotion; if smoke checks fail the installer automatically reverts Helm release and restores the previous dashboard configmap pointers. Testing: unit tests for terraform module, helm unit linting, and integration e2e against a minikube-like environment are included. Migration notes and manual operators steps are inlined in the README. This PR is intended to make observability upgrades non-disruptive and help customers keep SLAs during private upgrades.

review_comments: Rina Kapoor: High level this looks good; can you clarify how the migration lock behaves if a second upgrade is kicked off concurrently?

Lucas Meyer: The migration lock is a Terraform-managed resource (configmap) with ownerReferences incremented by installer; the script will fail fast if lock present and, in that case, recommend using --force to override only for emergency maintenance.
Diego Alvarez: The canary job looks racy when rules reference different scrape intervals; can we add a timeout and a rule-agnostic health-check?
Lucas Meyer: Added a timeout and a simple 'last_sample_ts' health probe that validates rule evaluations produced any recent samples; expanded test coverage to include variable scrape intervals.
Sophie Nguyen: Will immutable dashboards increase Grafana storage usage for long-lived tenants? How are stale configmaps garbage-collected?

Lucas Meyer: We retain N historical configmaps per dashboard (configurable via values.grafana.history_count) and provide a garbage-collection cronjob in terraform module that prunes older configmaps older than X days; default retention is 3 to limit storage.
Rina Kapoor: approved after addressing concurrent-lock handling and adding e2e to catch rule flakiness.

merge_summary: Merged after approvals from Rina, Diego, and Sophie. CI green; final change squashed into one commit that adds the monitoring upgrade plan module, helm canary flows, immutable dashboard provisioning, and the orchestration script. Backout tested via e2e and manual runbook.
release_notes: Private-installer: add atomic Prometheus upgrade flow with canary smoke-tests; Grafana dashboards now provisioned as immutable, content-hash configmaps with configurable history retention; new observability-upgrade orchestration script enables automated rollback on failure; terraform module monitoring_upgrade_plan added; see installer/README for runbook.
